class.name: OcgIntres2dTransition
class.brief_description: Definition of the type of transition near an intersection point between two curves. The transition is either a "true transition", which means that one of the curves goes inside or outside the area defined by the other curve near the intersection, or a "touch transition" which means that the first curve does not cross the other one, or an "undecided" transition, which means that the curves are superposed.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Creates an IN or OUT transition.

method.name: SetValue_2
method.description: Sets the values of an IN or OUT transition.

method.name: SetValue_3
method.description: Sets the values of a TOUCH transition.

method.name: SetValue_1
method.description: Sets the values of an UNDECIDED transition.

method.name: SetPosition
method.description: Sets the value of the position.

method.name: PositionOnCurve
method.description: Indicates if the intersection is at the beginning (IntRes2d_Head), at the end (IntRes2d_End), or in the middle (IntRes2d_Middle) of the curve.

method.name: TransitionType
method.description: Returns the type of transition at the intersection. It may be IN or OUT or TOUCH, or UNDECIDED if the two first derivatives are not enough to give the tangent to one of the two curves.

method.name: IsTangent
method.description: Returns TRUE when the 2 curves are tangent at the intersection point. Theexception DomainError is raised if the type of transition is UNDECIDED.

method.name: Situation
method.description: returns a significant value if TransitionType returns TOUCH. In this case, the function returns : INSIDE when the curve remains inside the other one, OUTSIDE when it remains outside the other one, UNKNOWN when the calculus, based on the second derivatives cannot give the result. If TransitionType returns IN or OUT or UNDECIDED, the exception DomainError is raised.

method.name: IsOpposite
method.description: returns a significant value if TransitionType returns TOUCH. In this case, the function returns true when the 2 curves locally define two different parts of the space. If TransitionType returns IN or OUT or UNDECIDED, the exception DomainError is raised.
